note: Synthetic stories for offline dry runs. Companies and URLs are invented. Do not treat any of this as real news.

stories.title: Example Health begins selling a pocket ultrasound scanner directly to consumers
stories.summary: Example Health said its handheld ultrasound probe is now available to buy online by anyone in the US, with no clinician account needed. Units ship this week.

stories.title: Researchers hope to build an invisibility fabric within a decade
stories.summary: A university team says it aims to develop a cloaking fabric for visible light and is seeking funding. No device has been shown.

stories.title: Startup claims its warp drive prototype will change travel forever
stories.summary: In a press release, a startup said it has built a warp drive prototype. It offered no data, no demonstration and no independent review.

stories.title: Sample Robotics starts shipping its home helper robot to customers
stories.summary: Sample Robotics confirmed the first consumer orders of its household robot were delivered. The robot folds laundry and loads a dishwasher, and is sold online.

stories.title: Translation app to try decoding unknown languages
stories.summary: An app maker says a future update may translate languages it has never seen. No results were shared.

stories.title: Local team wins regional football final
stories.summary: A late goal decided the match on Saturday.
